problem.title: Combinatorial Proof of Hurwitz and Discriminant Weight-Polytope Equality
problem.statement: Give a purely combinatorial proof that the weight polytope $W(\Delta_{X\times\mathbb{P}^{n-1}})$ of the discriminant coincides with the weight polytope $W(\operatorname{Hu}_A)$ of the Hurwitz form.
problem.background:

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The equality of the Hurwitz-form and discriminant weight polytopes is established, including by analytic and secondary-polytope methods, but the requested purely combinatorial reproof is explicitly left as a problem.

**Sources checked.**

- [Oberwolfach report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2025/19)
- [Sano, Weight Polytopes and Energy Functionals of Toric Varieties](https://doi.org/10.1007/s42543-023-00079-z)
